'''Nozho''' was a [[Domed city/Legends|domed city]] on [[Clak'dor VII/Legends|Clak'dor VII]]. It was destroyed around [[300 BBY/Legends|300 BBY]] in a biological attack during a [[Nozho–Weogar War/Legends|civil war]] on the planet. Most of its citizens died in the attack. Mutations in the surviving [[Bith/Legends|Bith]] populace gave rise to a subspecies known as the [[Y'bith/Legends|Y'bith]].
